title: Expected Visit Recursion
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $u$ and $v$ be vertices. For every natural number $N$, the expected number of visits to $v$ in $N+1$ steps starting at $u$ equals the average, over the $D$ possible first edge indices, of the indicator that the first step reaches $v$ plus the expected number of visits to $v$ in the remaining $N$ steps starting at the resulting neighbor.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
